summary: Today the packet prints a bare list of outcome names. Only revise and replan get a definition, and replan's uses internal jargon. Across 59 recorded runs (1,845 accepted results) the outcomes chosen were done 1,826, revise 11, blocked 6, replan 2, repeat 0. repeat is never used and cannot do what the duties offer it for. Both replans were really 'send back to system-test-author'. blocked_by was labelled inconsistently for the same need. In both revise steps of the 2026-10-17 runs, the model read ShipLoop's source to learn when revise is allowed and how a stopped loop maps to an outcome. Proposal: done, blocked, send-back and add-work, each printed with when to use it, what happens next and its shape. Remove repeat and blocked_by, check the budget before Improve and at --check-only, and name the outcome in every loop stop rule.

routes.R-RECORD: Every accepted outcome: accepted[action] = the canonical result and one history row {stage, outcome, summary, workitem, action} (navigator._record_acceptance); state revision += 1. Only done rows count as 'current' (shiploop_planning_revision.current_actions keeps the latest done per (item, stage)); duties say 'pending, repeat and blocked results are not plan authority' (shiploop_prompts DUTIES['release-plan'] item 1).
routes.R-DONE: Script gates of the row's complete_runs run first (CLI complete path in navigator.main); then, at a reviewed stage, an Improve child starts and its final_result may replace the result (navigator.apply, finish_improve); then _apply_result issues the next graph stage (_next_stage) and clears status_reason.
routes.R-REPEAT: Prelude/outer only. Recorded (R-RECORD), status active, a new action of the SAME stage (_apply_result 'repeat' branch: _new_action(stage)). No budget, no backward jump (references/navigator.md: '`repeat` does not jump backward'). Model supplies {outcome, summary} (+headline, evidence_refs); done-only fields refused (_DONE_ONLY_FIELDS).
routes.R-BLOCKED: Recorded; status = blocked, status_reason = '<blocked_by>: <summary>'; a new action of the SAME stage (prelude/outer _new_action, inner _replace_inner_action) (_apply_result). No budget. `resume` (control) reactivates; with `awaiting` it needs --answer (kind answer) or --observed (kind present), refuses 'continue'-type replies (_NOT_AN_ANSWER) and writes RUN/decisions/<action>.md, which the re-issued packet quotes (_answered_lines). Model supplies {outcome, summary, blocked_by: user|access|external} (BLOCKED_BY, BLOCKED_BY_RULE, enforced for new results in _apply_result); `awaiting` (AWAITING_SHAPE, with no_default: _check_submitted_awaiting) only with blocked_by user|access (_canonical_result). Inner stages: the Until Loop must be stopped, not active or cancelled, unless it never started (shiploop_loops.check_terminal, check_loop_packet).
routes.R-REVISE: test-spec..verify only. revisions[item] += 1, refused when already MAX_REVISES = 2 ('report blocked with blocked_by user and an awaiting question', _apply_result); cursor -> step-plan (_replace_inner_action(REVISE_TO)); current_actions drops the item's step-plan..carry-forward results (kept in accepted/history); the redone step-plan, test-spec and first implement packet print a Revisit line naming the previous result and the revise result (_sent_back_results, REVISIT_STAGES); the item reruns test-spec, validate-existing and every implement step (implement_progress counts from the latest step plan; plan unit D1). Model supplies {outcome, summary} (+ failed_expectations at validate-existing) and a stopped loop receipt (or ShipLoop's refused-run cap at test/verify: loops.check_terminal, _remedy_open, _verify_refused).
routes.R-REPLAN: Outer only. Corrective work_items appended (IDs must be new: 'corrective work IDs must be new'); stage -> inner-loop and the first corrective item's step-plan begins (_begin_inner_loop); each corrective item runs the whole inner loop with its Improve children; after the last one's carry-forward (and the end-of-work Improve) the outer phase restarts at system-test-author (_next_stage after carry-forward), not at the stage that replanned. Outer duties then read 'the latest done ... after the most recent accepted replan' (OUTER_TEST_HANDOFF); _replan_delta_lines scopes outer stages when the items changed only non-code paths; delivery-contract runs track replan_required (shiploop_consumer_delivery). No budget. Model supplies {outcome, summary, work_items:[{id,title,context}]}.
routes.R-RECONCILE: Not printed. _canonical_result accepts it only as the exact plan result {outcome, summary, evidence_refs, reconciliation_target}; apply and finish_improve refuse it ('reconcile requires improve-reconcile'). Only `improve-reconcile` after a stopped initial plan Improve child records it; current_actions then drops the planning suffix from the target (planning_revision.RECONCILIATION_TARGETS: discovery, research, spec, test-strategy).

vocabulary.meaning: This stage's work is finished: every Done-when (inner: exit) condition holds.
vocabulary.next: ShipLoop runs the stage's checks, then starts the next stage (named in the line).
vocabulary.model_supplies: the result template (stage fields); inner stages: a complete Until Loop receipt.

vocabulary.meaning: Only someone outside this run can unblock the stage (a person's answer, sign-in or grant, or an outside service), and no change to the plan avoids it.
vocabulary.next: The run stops; it resumes at this stage with their reply.
vocabulary.model_supplies: {outcome, summary}; `awaiting` (reference#blocked) when a person must answer or act; inner stages: the Until Loop ended as stopped (or never started).

Repeat while a case has no test or the latest iteration found ... and changed code or tests to fix it; there is no iteration limit. End the loop as stopped when a failure is proven unachievable as planned or a recorded command cannot run here (the stage then reports send-back), or when only a person or an outside service can unblock it (the stage then reports blocked). Never stop cancelled: a user's stop is the ShipLoop packet's pause command.
Result: when the Receipt says complete, report done; when it says stopped, report send-back or blocked. Keep the receipt in evidence_refs and run the Callback command above.
A refusal does not advance the run: fix the cause and run the same command again; `complete --check-only` prints the first refusal without accepting, so run it again until it accepts.

Refused runs for this action so far: N (base, candidate and mutation runs together). A wrong check or command is send-back at any time with the stopped loop receipt; after repeated refusals ShipLoop also accepts send-back without one.
